data.one_liner: A Flutter Popup Menu Widget written completely in Dart supporting both iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable popup menu widget written completely in Dart. Supports displaying items with icons and text or custom container content.
use_when: You need a customizable popup menu widget with icons and text.
You want a pure Dart implementation of a popup menu.
avoid_when: You require a show/hide animation which is currently in the todo list.
You only want to use the standard platform popup menu widgets.
strengths: Supports custom menu content and configuration
Works across multiple platforms including Android and iOS
weaknesses: Show/hide animation is currently listed as not implemented (todo)
data.minimal_example:
PopupMenu menu = PopupMenu(
      context: context,
      config: const MenuConfig(
        backgroundColor: Colors.green,
        lineColor: Colors.greenAccent,
        highlightColor: Colors.lightGreenAccent,
      ),
      items: [
        PopUpMenuItem(title: 'Copy', image: Image.asset('assets/copy.png')),
        PopUpMenuItem(title: 'Home', image: Icon(Icons.home, color: Colors.white)),
      ],
      onClickMenu: onClickMenu,
      onShow: onShow,
      onDismiss: onDismiss);

menu.show(rect: rect);
